en.title: Prepare FAO Catch Data for CMSY++
en.description:
This function turns FAO catch data into the two input files of CMSY++ (Froese et al. 2021,
2023): the catch file (`Stock`, `yr`, `ct`, `bt`) and the ID file, one row per stock, with
the priors and settings. Each stock gets its resilience and r prior from the built-in
FishBase and SeaLifeBase table (see `cmsy_priors()`), with the source of each value.
en.details:
The FAO statistics contain catches only, with no abundance index (CPUE or survey biomass), so
every stock is assessed with the catch-only part of CMSY++ (CMSY: `btype = "None"`, `bt` empty)
and the Bayesian Schaefer model (BSM) is not run. The results then depend mostly on the
priors for relative biomass (B/k), which CMSY++ sets with its neural network unless they are
given in `priors`; they are indicative and do not replace stock assessments.

A stock is the yearly catch of one FAO species item in one fishing area, summed over all
countries (`by = "area"`, as in `stock_status()`), or of one country (`by = "country"`). Only
items identified to species and measured in tonnes are used. Following the user guide, years
must be consecutive and gaps are not allowed: a stock starts with its first and ends with its
last year with catch, and missing or zero catches in between are filled by linear
interpolation between the adjacent years (the number of filled years is reported). Stocks are
left out when they have fewer than `min_years` years (CMSY++ uses the first and the last ten
years for its default priors), less than `min_catch` tonnes in total, more than
`max_filled` of their years filled, or no prior for r.

Every stock keeps the links to the sources of its data and priors: `url` (the FishBase or
SeaLifeBase page of the species), `data_url` (the FishBase or SeaLifeBase table the prior was
read from), `rule_url` (the CMSY++ user guide) and `fao_data_url` (the FAO data release).
en.value:
Invisibly, a list of class `cmsy_input` with `catch` and `id` (the two CMSY++ input
tables), `stocks` (one row per stock with its species, area, years, filled years, catch
and the source of its r prior) and `excluded` (stocks left out, with the reason).
When `table` is TRUE the four tables are saved in `tables/cmsy/`.

arguments.area_data:
FAO catch data: `fishing_area_data()$area_data`, or any subset of
`load_fao_data()` (e.g. one country, or several fishing areas).
arguments.species:
Optional species to keep, by English or Chinese FAO name, both together (as
shown with `lang = "both"`), scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code, e.g.
`c("European pilchard(=Sardine)", "Sardinella aurita", "BOG")` or Chinese names.
Default is NULL, all species.
arguments.by:
"area" (default): one stock per species item and fishing area, summed over
countries; or "country": one stock per species item, fishing area and country.
arguments.priors:
Optional data frame of priors and settings that replace the defaults, one row
per stock or species. It identifies the rows by a `Stock`, `alpha3`, `species_en` or
`species` column (`species`: any name, as in the `species` argument) and can have any of the ID file columns `Resilience`, `r.low`, `r.hi`,
`stb.low`, `stb.hi`, `int.yr`, `intb.low`, `intb.hi`, `endb.low`, `endb.hi`,
`StartYear`, `EndYear` and `Comment`. Values given here are recorded as "user".
arguments.default_resilience:
Resilience ("High", "Medium", "Low" or "Very low") for stocks
whose species has no resilience or prior r in FishBase or SeaLifeBase. Default is NULL:
such stocks are left out, since the user guide gives no default.
arguments.min_years: Minimum number of years from the first to the last year with catch. Default is 10.
arguments.min_catch: Minimum total catch of a stock, in tonnes. Default is 1000.
arguments.max_filled:
Maximum share of the years of a stock that may be filled by interpolation.
Default is 0.2.
arguments.table: A logical value. If TRUE (default), tables are saved in `tables/`.
arguments.lang:
The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or
"both" (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with
`fao_settings()` ("en" unless changed).
arguments.label:
The name used in the output file names. Default is the fishing area (or the
country) of the data.
arguments.silent:
A logical value. If TRUE, no messages are printed. Default is FALSE, or the value
set with `fao_settings(silent = )`.

zh.title: 将FAO渔获数据转换为CMSY++输入文件
zh.description: 本函数将FAO渔获数据转换为CMSY++（Froese等，2021，2023）的两个输入文件：渔获量文件（`Stock`、`yr`、`ct`、`bt`）和ID文件（每个种群一行，包含先验和设置）。每个种群的恢复力和种群内禀增长率r的先验取自本包内置的FishBase和SeaLifeBase数据表（见`cmsy_priors()`），并注明每个值的来源。
zh.details:
FAO统计数据只有渔获量，没有资源丰度指数（CPUE或调查生物量），因此每个种群都只用CMSY++中仅基于渔获量的部分（CMSY：`btype = "None"`，`bt`为空）进行评估，不运行贝叶斯Schaefer模型（BSM）。因此，结果主要取决于相对生物量（B/k）的先验；除非在`priors`中给出，这些先验由CMSY++的人工神经网络设定。结果仅供参考，不能替代资源评估。

一个种群是指一个FAO物种条目在一个渔区内的年渔获量，可以是所有国家的合计（`by = "area"`，与`stock_status()`相同），也可以是单个国家的渔获量（`by = "country"`）。只使用鉴定到种且以吨为单位的条目。按照用户指南的要求，年份必须连续，不允许有缺口：种群从有渔获量的第一年开始，到有渔获量的最后一年结束，其间缺失或为零的渔获量用相邻年份之间的线性插值填补（会报告填补的年数）。以下种群不予纳入：年数少于`min_years`（CMSY++用最初十年和最后十年设定默认先验）、总渔获量少于`min_catch`吨、填补年份所占比例超过`max_filled`，或没有r先验。

每个种群都保留其数据和先验来源的链接：`url`（该物种的FishBase或SeaLifeBase页面）、`data_url`（读取先验所用的FishBase或SeaLifeBase数据表）、`rule_url`（CMSY++用户指南）和`fao_data_url`（FAO数据的发布版本）。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回一个`cmsy_input`类的列表，包含`catch`和`id`（CMSY++的两个输入表）、`stocks`（每个种群一行，包括物种、渔区、年份、填补的年份、渔获量及其r先验的来源）和`excluded`（未纳入的种群及原因）。`table`为TRUE时，这四个表格保存在tables/cmsy/。

arguments.area_data: FAO渔获数据：`fishing_area_data()$area_data`，或`load_fao_data()`的任意子集（例如一个国家，或几个渔区）。
arguments.species: 要保留的物种（可选），可以用FAO英文或中文名称、中英文名称合写（与`lang = "both"`时显示的形式相同）、学名或FAO三字母代码，例如`c("European pilchard(=Sardine)", "Sardinella aurita", "BOG")`，也可以用中文名称。默认为NULL，即所有物种。
arguments.by: "area"（默认）：每个物种条目和渔区为一个种群，按国家合计；"country"：每个物种条目、渔区和国家为一个种群。
arguments.priors: 可选的数据框，给出用于替代默认值的先验和设置，每个种群或物种一行。用`Stock`、`alpha3`、`species_en`或`species`列识别各行（`species`：任何名称，与`species`参数相同），并可包含ID文件的以下任意列：`Resilience`、`r.low`、`r.hi`、`stb.low`、`stb.hi`、`int.yr`、`intb.low`、`intb.hi`、`endb.low`、`endb.hi`、`StartYear`、`EndYear`和`Comment`。在这里给出的值，其来源记为"user"（用户）。
arguments.default_resilience: 物种在FishBase或SeaLifeBase中没有恢复力或r先验时，其种群所用的恢复力（"High"、"Medium"、"Low"或"Very low"）。默认为NULL：由于用户指南没有给出默认值，这类种群不予纳入。
arguments.min_years: 从有渔获量的第一年到最后一年的最少年数。默认为10。
arguments.min_catch: 一个种群的最小总渔获量，单位为吨。默认为1000。
arguments.max_filled: 一个种群中可用插值填补的年份所占的最大比例。默认为0.2。
arguments.table: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/。
arguments.lang: 图表文字和名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（未更改时为"en"）。
arguments.label: 输出文件名中使用的名称。默认为数据所属的渔区（或国家）。
arguments.silent: 逻辑值。为TRUE时不输出任何提示信息。默认为FALSE，或使用`fao_settings(silent = )`设置的值。
